title: <i>Mission Life, or, The Emigrant and the Heathen</i>
---

This was a periodical published by Rivington, which ran from 1866 to 1890.

It was edited by the Rev. [J. J.

Halcombe](/person/604), editorial secretary to the SPCK.

It is not to be confused with the Mission Field, the organ of the SPG. CMY commented (1 Jan 1872) on the details of Bishop Patteson\'s death provided by Charles Hyde Brooke’s account in Mission Life.
